title: Glasnost-era Russian crashed craft, US astronaut sent to help retrieve it

tellings.quote: one story that came up was that in the early days of glasnost when Russia and America were kind of friends again. Mhm. Russia imparted to America that it was in possession of a crashed craft

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, passes on a story someone told him. He says that during glasnost, the period around the late 1980s when the Soviet Union opened up and it was friendlier with America, Russia told the United States it had a crashed craft, and an American astronaut was reportedly sent to help recover it. If true, it would mean the two rival powers once quietly worked together on something not of human make.
